_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% directional movement over 72 12h windows confirms a coil with no breaker visible — fed_liquidity at 0 and VIX at 70 create macro pressure but locked exchange reserves (97th percentile) and long-term cycle support (pi_cycle 90, ma_200w 95) prevent collapse, trapping price in Denial until a catalyst forces the coil to break.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both call current phase Denial, but the analyst forward-calls Disbelief with medium conviction and explicit HOLD direction while the narrative writer implies upward resolution through accumulation; the analyst's 0-for-14 record and deeper trust weight (7.67) anchor the consensus toward HOLD over directional bets.
next_move.confirmed_if: btc_momentum_30d breaks above 55 with stablecoin_growth recovering above 50 and fed_liquidity ticking off 0 — this would validate the narrative's accumulation thesis and move phase to Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: mvrv_zscore drops below 15 with no bid OR VIX spikes above 80 accompanied by btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d dropping (supply panic-selling into macro shock) — this would break the coil downward through Denial into Panic
